ai_review.summary: Incredible sound from cassette masters captures a smoking performance of "The Wheel"
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear audio quality of this digitized cassette master and highlight the opening of "The Wheel" as a standout moment, suggesting a high‑energy show despite the unknown setlist details.

ai_rating.rationale: A perfect 5‑star rating and praise for both performance and audio indicate an exceptional recording, though only one review limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as "incredible"; digitized from cassette masters implying a clean, well‑preserved source.
